findings.title: Sensitive configuration uses a public environment name
findings.description: A sensitive-looking setting has a browser-public naming convention. No active credential or actual browser bundle exposure has been verified.
findings.remediation: Keep privileged credentials in server-only configuration. If exposure is verified, rotate the credential and review its use.

evidence.observation: Rule TW-005 matched a review-relevant code pattern. Runtime exploitability is unverified.

findings.title: Destructive agent tool needs permission review
findings.description: A potentially destructive operation appears in an agent tool list. The pattern cannot determine whether approval and authorization are enforced inside the tool.
findings.remediation: Apply authorization inside each tool, restrict its capability, and require explicit approval where the operation warrants it.

evidence.observation: Rule TW-007 matched a review-relevant code pattern. Runtime exploitability is unverified.

findings.title: Dynamic code execution needs trust-boundary review
findings.description: A dynamic execution sink was detected. This is a pattern match, not proof of attacker-controlled execution.
findings.remediation: Replace dynamic code execution with explicit operations where possible; otherwise document and enforce the trust boundary.

evidence.observation: Rule TW-003 matched a review-relevant code pattern. Runtime exploitability is unverified.

findings.title: Raw SQL execution needs input tracing
findings.description: An unsafe SQL execution API is present. User control of the query and runtime reachability have not been established.
findings.remediation: Prefer parameterized queries. Trace every value reaching this call before deciding whether an injection vulnerability exists.

evidence.observation: Rule TW-001 matched a review-relevant code pattern. Runtime exploitability is unverified.

findings.title: Object lookup needs tenant authorization review
findings.description: An object lookup begins with an ID filter. This is a review hotspot, not evidence of a missing authorization check; inspect middleware, service policy, RLS and the complete call path.
findings.remediation: Verify object-level access for the authenticated tenant. Add a regression test using two tenants and reject cross-tenant access.

evidence.observation: Rule TW-004 matched a review-relevant code pattern. Runtime exploitability is unverified.

findings.title: HTML rendering bypass needs sanitization review
findings.description: Raw HTML reaches a React rendering sink. The scanner does not prove that the value is attacker-controlled or unsanitized.
findings.remediation: Establish the source of the HTML and verify an appropriate sanitizer. Prefer rendering text when rich HTML is unnecessary.

evidence.observation: Rule TW-002 matched a review-relevant code pattern. Runtime exploitability is unverified.

findings.title: Wildcard cross-origin policy needs context review
findings.description: A wildcard CORS origin was found. Public endpoints may intentionally permit it; authentication and exposed data determine the risk.
findings.remediation: Define expected browser origins and validate the credential model. Do not treat CORS as an authorization mechanism.

evidence.observation: Rule TW-006 matched a review-relevant code pattern. Runtime exploitability is unverified.

controls.title: Sensitive mutations authenticate a principal
controls.rationale: No supported sensitive mutation boundary was mapped.
controls.applicability: Applies to mapped mutating routes and server actions that reach database, raw SQL, command, or file operations. Webhooks are evaluated separately.
controls.verification: Test each boundary without a session/token and confirm rejection before the sensitive operation.
limitations: Gateway, middleware, identity-provider, and database policy outside the bounded map may change the result.

controls.title: Sensitive read routes receive an authentication review
controls.rationale: No missing-authentication candidate was found across 2 mapped sensitive read route(s).
controls.applicability: Applies to mapped Next.js GET and HEAD routes that reach database, raw SQL, command, or file operations.
controls.verification: Test anonymous and wrong-tenant reads. Confirm intentionally public routes expose only approved fields.
limitations: Gateway controls and public-route intent outside the captured source remain unverified.

controls.title: Administrative mutations enforce permission
controls.rationale: No supported admin/internal mutation boundary was mapped.
controls.applicability: Applies to mapped admin/internal routes and actions that reach sensitive operations.
controls.verification: Test an authenticated non-admin principal against every privileged action.

controls.title: Dynamic resource access is tenant or owner scoped
controls.rationale: 0 of 1 dynamic database boundary(s) contain a recognized tenant, owner, account, organization, or user scope in the captured call arguments.
controls.applicability: Applies when a caller-selectable path parameter reaches a mapped database operation.
controls.verification: Run cross-tenant and wrong-owner identifier tests and inspect effective RLS/database policy.
limitations: Scope passed through an unrecognized object or enforced by RLS may remain unverified.

controls.title: Sensitive entry points validate caller-controlled input
controls.rationale: 0 of 2 sensitive entry point(s) contain a recognized validation call within five explicit call hops.
controls.applicability: Applies to mapped routes/actions that reach sensitive operations.
controls.verification: Test malformed, oversized, unexpected-type, and boundary input before the sensitive operation.
limitations: Inline/manual validation and framework coercion may not be recognized.

controls.title: Raw SQL keeps request data out of query structure
controls.rationale: 1 raw SQL input-flow candidate(s) require review.
controls.applicability: Applies when mapped request/action code reaches raw SQL execution.
controls.verification: Trace each query fragment, replace structural interpolation with parameters, and test metacharacter payloads without modifying production data.
limitations: Indirect builders, ORM-specific safe tagged templates, and database-side controls may require manual review.

controls.title: Outbound destinations are server-owned or safely constrained
controls.rationale: No supported outbound request boundary was mapped.
controls.applicability: Applies when mapped entry points can initiate server-side network requests.
controls.verification: Test untrusted public, private, loopback, metadata, DNS-rebinding, and redirect destinations against the effective egress policy.
limitations: Network egress controls and DNS behavior are outside source-only evidence.

controls.title: Redirect destinations are constrained
controls.rationale: No supported redirect boundary was mapped.
controls.applicability: Applies when mapped entry points construct a redirect response.
controls.verification: Test external, scheme-relative, encoded, mixed-case, and userinfo-form destinations against the effective redirect policy.

controls.title: File uploads enforce size, content, and storage-path constraints
controls.rationale: No decisive upload gap was mapped, but the profiler cannot prove that uploads are absent or fully constrained.
controls.applicability: Applies when an HTTP boundary accepts files or multipart form data.
controls.verification: Test byte limits, file count, MIME/content mismatch, polyglots, generated names, traversal, overwrite, and storage execution policy.
limitations: Streaming parsers and framework upload middleware may not be recognized.

controls.title: Webhook authenticity is verified before processing
controls.rationale: No supported webhook/callback boundary reaching a sensitive operation was mapped.
controls.applicability: Applies to webhook/callback routes that reach sensitive operations.
controls.verification: Send missing, invalid, replayed, and stale signatures and confirm rejection before parsing or persistence.
limitations: Provider SDK verification with an unrecognized function name may remain unverified.

controls.title: Browser security policies are declared and observed
controls.rationale: No effective runtime response was available to confirm browser policies.
controls.applicability: Applies to mapped Next.js applications with browser-facing responses.
controls.verification: Observe representative production responses and verify CSP, frame, MIME, referrer, permissions, and transport policies.
limitations: One URL does not establish policy coverage for every route or deployment layer.

controls.title: Sensitive cookies use explicit protection attributes
controls.rationale: No cookie-based session signal was mapped.
controls.applicability: Applies when captured source uses cookie-based authentication/session state.
controls.verification: Inspect effective Set-Cookie attributes and test production HTTPS, expiry, logout, fixation, and CSRF behavior.

controls.title: Cross-origin access is intentionally constrained
controls.rationale: No effective cross-origin policy was observed; same-origin-only operation is possible but unverified.
controls.applicability: Applies to mapped HTTP API entry points.
controls.verification: Test trusted and untrusted Origin values, credential mode, preflight behavior, and server-side authorization independently.
